about: Annotated studies of the best public-service weather pages (and BBC Weather, Dinis's reference): numbered callouts placed on the page as this agent drew and saw it (1280 x 1600 px, top of the page), each saying what the part does well and which of our data files would feed the same part. `cross` groups the same part across countries. Not studied: DWD's warnings page (it drew without its stylesheet in our browser, so there was nothing fair to annotate).

parts.what-to-expect: What to expect (the warning in words)

studies.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)

now.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
now.title: The next hour, very large
now.does_well: "NEXT HOUR 9°C Light rain": the page answers "what now" before anything else.

now.name: US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
now.title: Observed now, at a named station
now.does_well: "Current conditions at New York City, Central Park (KNYC)", with coordinates, and "Last update 10 Nov 8:51 pm EST": an observation is tied to its station and time.

now.name: KNMI: warnings
now.title: The state in one plain line
now.does_well: "Er zijn geen waarschuwingen" (there are no warnings), as a line of text above the map, and again as a heading.

warning-map.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
warning-map.title: Hazards as a filter
warning-map.does_well: All, Wind, Rainfalls, Storms, Coastal: one click redraws the map for one hazard.

warning-map.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
warning-map.title: The map by warning zone
warning-map.does_well: Zones smaller than provinces, in the four European colours; the red zone is visible at once among the orange.

warning-map.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
warning-map.title: A map with a play button and a week of time
warning-map.does_well: Rain over a satellite-style base map, a time bar from Wednesday to Tuesday, "Long forecast" and "Pressure" views.

warning-map.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
warning-map.title: One colour per département
warning-map.does_well: The whole country at a glance, with the Paris area enlarged in an inset.

warning-map.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
warning-map.title: Maps per phenomenon
warning-map.does_well: A list of the hazards in force ("Orages"); choosing one redraws the map for it.

warning-map.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
warning-map.title: Every district with its highest level
warning-map.does_well: A list on the right: the district's name and a chip ("Vermelho", "Laranja"); the one shown is marked.

warning-map.name: MeteoAlarm: Portugal
warning-map.title: The country by warning area
warning-map.does_well: Districts in yellow and orange on the mainland, Madeira in red, at the hour chosen.

warning-map.name: MeteoAlarm: Portugal
warning-map.title: Short-term and long-term hazards
warning-map.does_well: Tabs that separate wind, rain and coast from slower hazards.

warning-map.name: MeteoAlarm: Portugal
warning-map.title: Filters by level and by hazard

warning-map.name: KNMI: warnings
warning-map.title: A quiet map
warning-map.does_well: The country with no colour at all when nothing is in force.

warning-over-time.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
warning-over-time.title: Three days, three dots, in the header
warning-over-time.does_well: Wed 11 red, Thu 12 orange, Fri 13 yellow: the highest level of each of the next three days sits beside the menu on every page of the site.

warning-over-time.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
warning-over-time.title: A time bar with play
warning-over-time.does_well: Three day tabs (each "00-24h") and a play button that runs the map through time.

warning-over-time.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
warning-over-time.title: The matrix: regions against time
warning-over-time.does_well: One row per region; the hazards in force as small icons framed in their level's colour; then one coloured cell per period across the three days. The whole country's next three days in one table. A feed icon on every row.

warning-over-time.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
warning-over-time.title: Day tabs with high and low
warning-over-time.does_well: Eight days in a row; the selected day is joined to the card.

warning-over-time.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
warning-over-time.title: A bar per hazard along the day
warning-over-time.does_well: Hours 0h to 0h across; one bar per phenomenon, coloured for the hours it applies. Floods link to the river service.

warning-over-time.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
warning-over-time.title: Eight hazards by 72 hours
warning-over-time.does_well: One row per hazard (thunder, sea state, rain, wind, snow, cold, heat, fog), one cell per hour for three days, green to red: when each hazard starts and stops, in one picture.

warning-over-time.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
warning-over-time.title: Days marked under the grid
warning-over-time.does_well: "11 nov", "12 nov", "13 nov" with hour ticks at 00, 06, 12, 18.

warning-over-time.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
warning-over-time.title: The day tab carries the warning
warning-over-time.does_well: Under each day: min, max, wind, rain probability, and a label in the level's colour ("Amarelo", "Vermelho", "Amarelo").

warning-over-time.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
warning-over-time.title: The warnings as a row of the table
warning-over-time.does_well: "Avisos Meteorológicos": one cell per hour, yellow, then orange, then red from 09H to 21H. The best row on the page, placed last.

warning-over-time.name: MeteoAlarm: Portugal
warning-over-time.title: Now, +24h, each day, animation
warning-over-time.does_well: A row of buttons under the validity window "Tu 2026.11.10 23:00 - We 2026.11.11 02:00 (GMT+0)".

hour-by-hour.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
hour-by-hour.title: Three chips, one of them the gust
hour-by-hour.does_well: "Feels like 7°", "Light rain ≥95%", "Max gust 19mph from the northeast": the gust is named in the summary, in words, with its direction.

hour-by-hour.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
hour-by-hour.title: The hourly table, gust on its own row
hour-by-hour.does_well: Per hour: symbol, temperature, feels like, chance of rain, mean wind with arrow, and under it the gust. Mean wind and gust are never confused.

hour-by-hour.name: US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
hour-by-hour.title: Nine periods in a strip
hour-by-hour.does_well: Day and night as separate periods; the chance of rain printed on the picture; high or low; two or three words.

hour-by-hour.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
hour-by-hour.title: The hour columns
hour-by-hour.does_well: Hour, symbol, temperature, chance of rain, wind speed in a circle with its direction. Tap an hour for more.

hour-by-hour.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
hour-by-hour.title: Rain probability by three-hour block
hour-by-hour.does_well: "100%" across the morning and afternoon of Wednesday, "24%" at the end.

hour-by-hour.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
hour-by-hour.title: Mean wind, hour by hour
hour-by-hour.does_well: An arrow, a figure in km/h and a direction per hour: 11 to 23 km/h. This is the automatic mean wind, not the gust the warning speaks of.

hour-by-hour.name: Yr: Lisbon, hour by hour
hour-by-hour.title: The calm table
hour-by-hour.does_well: Time, symbol, temperature, precipitation in mm, wind in m/s with an arrow. No decoration.

what-to-expect.name: AEMET: meteorological warnings
what-to-expect.title: The special notice, in words
what-to-expect.does_well: One line above the map: "Aviso especial. Lluvias fuertes y persistentes, rachas muy fuertes y temporal marítimo." The forecasters' own headline before any colour.

what-to-expect.name: US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
what-to-expect.title: A sentence per period, with numbers
what-to-expect.does_well: "Rain. High near 59. East wind 9 to 11 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible." Ranges, not single values.

what-to-expect.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
what-to-expect.title: One sentence for the period
what-to-expect.does_well: "Tonight: Thundery showers and a gentle breeze", with the low. A whole forecast in six words.

what-to-expect.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
what-to-expect.title: What is not there: any warning
what-to-expect.does_well: No banner, colour or word about IPMA's red wind and rain warnings for the next day; the sentence says "a gentle breeze". A model without the authority. Our page starts where this one is silent.

what-to-expect.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
what-to-expect.title: Each warning as a bar with its sentence
what-to-expect.does_well: "Vento - Vermelho [11 Nov 12:00 - 11 Nov 21:00]" and under it "Rajadas até 120 km/h, podendo atingir 140 km/h nos locais mais expostos." Hazard, level, period, and what to expect.

what-to-expect.name: Yr: Lisbon, hour by hour
what-to-expect.title: Warnings with a status word
what-to-expect.does_well: Five banners for Lisboa: "Ongoing: Yellow Coastal Event Warning", "Expected: Orange Rain Warning", "Expected: Red Rain Warning", "Expected: Red Wind Warning", "Expected: Orange Coastal Event Warning". Each opens for the text.

what-to-expect.name: MeteoAlarm: Portugal
what-to-expect.title: One row per warning
what-to-expect.does_well: The hazard's pictogram on its level's colour, then the area: Lisboa appears three times, once per warning.

what-to-do.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
what-to-do.title: A legend of actions
what-to-do.does_well: "Vigilance absolue", "Soyez très vigilant", "Soyez attentif", "Pas de vigilance particulière": each colour is what to do.

what-to-do.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
what-to-do.title: The criteria, linked
what-to-do.does_well: "Critérios de emissão": what makes a warning yellow, orange or red.

what-to-do.name: KNMI: warnings
what-to-do.title: What it warns for
what-to-do.does_well: One sentence listing the hazards KNMI warns about.

what-to-do.name: KNMI: warnings
what-to-do.title: What can I expect and what can I do
what-to-do.does_well: One link per hazard: thunderstorms, heavy gusts and storm, snow, ice, heavy rain, cold, heat.

uncertainty.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
uncertainty.title: Ten day tabs; the far ones marked BETA
uncertainty.does_well: High and low per day; days eight to ten carry a "BETA" label: lower confidence is marked on the tab itself.

uncertainty.name: US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
uncertainty.title: The forecast discussion
uncertainty.does_well: A link to the forecasters' own reasoning, in text, for this office.

uncertainty.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
uncertainty.title: The caveat, in the notes
uncertainty.does_well: The page explains that this automatic forecast may differ from the forecasters' descriptive forecast and from the warnings, which should be consulted. True and far from the numbers it qualifies.

uncertainty.name: Yr: Lisbon, hour by hour
uncertainty.title: Wind in words
uncertainty.does_well: "Fresh breeze from south east": a reader who does not think in metres per second still understands. But the words describe the automatic mean wind under a red wind warning, and the page does not say so.

times.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
times.title: When it was updated
times.does_well: "Updated: 1am on 11 November 2026", directly under the table.

times.name: US National Weather Service: point forecast (New York)
times.title: About this forecast
times.does_well: The point, "Last Update", "Forecast Valid" from and to, and the data as KML and XML: provenance in a box of its own.

times.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
times.title: Last updated
times.does_well: "Last updated today at 23:02", small, under the hours.

times.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
times.title: Issued, and valid until
times.does_well: "émise le 10 novembre 2026 à 16h00 … valable jusqu'au 12 novembre 2026 à 00h00": two times under the title.

times.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
times.title: Today, tomorrow, and when the next map comes
times.does_well: Two tabs; tomorrow's is grey and says "Prochaine carte à 06h".

times.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
times.title: The rhythm, stated
times.does_well: "Les cartes de vigilance météo sont actualisées au moins 2 fois par jour à 6h et 16h."

times.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline (Lisboa)
times.title: UTC, and the last update
times.does_well: "Toda a informação em horas UTC" and "Última atualização: terça, 10 de novembro de 2026 às 21:23".

times.name: IPMA: hourly forecast for a place (Lisboa)
times.title: When it was made

data.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
data.title: A PDF version
data.does_well: The same card as a document to forward.

navigation.name: Met Office: forecast for a place (London)
navigation.title: Five views of one forecast
navigation.does_well: Daily, Detailed, Map, Long range, UK: the same place at five depths, as tabs.

navigation.name: BBC Weather: Lisbon
navigation.title: The place, and nothing else, as the title
navigation.does_well: "Lisbon" over a weather photograph; one button to keep it.

navigation.name: Yr: Lisbon, hour by hour
navigation.title: Previous day, next day
navigation.does_well: Two buttons; the table is one day at a time.
